reviews.text: I have been coming here for about 30 years.  They have helped me through illnesses, back issues, allergies, cancer.  I recommend people all the time if they want quality care.
Sam did a fantastic job grooming Chewy today.!  Thank you for being so good with Chewy !

We recently adopted a puppy and have had a fabulous experience at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital. Professional and kind staff. They were highly recommended to us as we tried to make a decision on what vet to choose. So glad we took our pup there as well as the grooming salon:)

Athena did a wonderful job grooming my handsome boy! She was kind, professional and clearly takes pride in her work.  He looked so handsome, clean and so well cared for when I picked him up. I really appreciate the attention Athena gave him and how great the entire experience was at King's Crossing Animal Hospital.  I would absolutely recommend Athena to anyone looking for a groomer they can trust with their pet. We'll definitely be back!
Annual exam and shots for rabies and other required vaccines. On time service when we arrived.

My dog has needed to randomly be seen twice now and for the second time they were able to work me in last minute to see my dog. The staff is so extremely kind. They always answer my call and help make a stressful situation much easier. Thank you so much guys you rock.
Wally has been going to Samantha for a couple years now. She does a great job and is a wonderful person. We really enjoyed her. And thankful we found her.❤️

Irene, thank you for taking the time to leave us a 4-star rating! We appreciate your support of Kings Crossing Animal Hospital and are always looking for ways to make every visit a 5-star experience. We look forward to caring for you and your pet again!
Loves Dr. Bumgardner!! Excellent service!!!
Always easy to work with get in for an appointment

My two senior pups came in for an exam on September 16th.   Our tech was Brenna and our vet was Dr. Johnson.  The concerns I had were discussed and explained in a professional and comfortable manner.
The experience was wonderful, I envy my pups!
The boys stayed calm and the chihuahua even tried to kiss both Brenna and Dr. Johnson!  That was a first for him at a vet appointment!
Oh, the front desk staff are also friendly and on point!
Thank you for a great experience!
Amy C.  (and Murphy and Mikey)
Excellent service 🙌 …

Samy has groomed my Yorkie Toby several times
and I have been very pleased, I could highly recommend her and Kings Crossing Animal Hospital
and Grooming

Kings Crossing Animal Hospital has been there for me and my babies in times of happiness and goodbye. They are always so loving and you can tell the entire staff really cares. Special shout out to Jenny for helping me wrangle my herd and giving each one of them the love and attention they each demanded of her.

Excellent service ! Easy to get an appointment and very professional! We’ve been with Kings Crossing Animal Hospital for 15 years and love their service ! We fully trust them with our precious Yorkies. They have an outstanding team of vets, vet assistants, groomers and office staff !
Athena did a great job grooming our golden doodle!!
Kingscrossing Vet is the best. I just love Dr. Bumgarner and Dr. Johnson is great too. Billie is great at the front desk always there to help with whatever I need. Can’t go wrong going to this vet.

I took my very sick old dog to this animal hospital. I got very for the service provided to my dog. The lady vet explained well and clearly what the problem with my dog was, she was very professional, as so was the rest of the staff.
I am very impressed, and highly recommend this hospital to anybody that needs a vet to take care of a pet/animal.
They helped get an old dog up and running again.
Wonderful staff. Prompt service from caring professionals.

We recently adopted a hospice rescue and didn't know what to expect. Dr. Johnson saw us immediately and gave us great information on her condition and how to care for her and make her comfortable. She and her team have taken care of every one of our dogs for the past 10 years, through the highs and lows, and there is not another place I would take any of my pups!

I absolute love this place. Our dog is paralyzed on her hind legs due to IVDD and needs constant care and attention. All the staff at Kings crossing, from front desk to the vet,  are exceptionally nice. They are friendly, professional and extremely competent. Pebbles, our dog, loves them. The grooming portion is wonderful and Sam, the groomer who usually takes care of pebbles, is by far the best groomer I've ever met. I completely recommend this place for anyone who has a pet.

I wanted to give a shout out of a special thanks to Dr Lam and the entire staff at the Kings Crossing Animal Hospital for taking care of my two cats Lu Lu and Pumpkin… Dr Lams assistant was wonderful as she saw them first and trimmed their nails and initially looked them over, and her questions to me were spot on…. I’m not good with names so please forgive me as the assistants name has slipped me…
I can get to the clinic much faster now as it is close to me and having a boarding business is a major plus…
Thank you for all your kindness ..
Ralph B
Kingwood Tx

Saul, we're so grateful for your 5-star review! Thank you for choosing Kings Crossing Animal Hospital for your pet's care. We appreciate your trust and look forward to welcoming you back for your next visit!
Dr.Lam is the best
Fantastic service, staff and care.

I had a great experience at this animal hospital. Everyone was very friendly and helpful from the moment I walked in. A special thank you to Itzel at the front desk for being so welcoming and making everything quick and easy. Dr. J was amazing with my dog, Kayla. They took the time to explain everything, answered all of my questions, and treated Kayla with so much care. I’m very thankful for the excellent service and highly recommend this animal hospital to anyone looking for a caring and professional team.
KCAH has always taken the best care of our pets! Wonderful staff and they’re easy to schedule with.
Dr. Lam is great! She is very thorough and takes her time explaining things, and more importantly, she is patient when it comes to listening to any concerns we may have.
Kevin, thank you for the 5 star rating! Everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital appreciates your support and we look forward to seeing you again soon!
Very friendly and knowledgeable staff.
I’m always confident my dog is cared for when I leave for them for boarding or other veterinary services. Athena is also an expert groomer!

My babies (2 shi-tzus) always come back happy and super soft and looking cute. One of our dogs has a problem on his back and we love that the whole staff here is very careful with him and very patient.
Dr. B and the entire staff are amazing and caring!  My dogs are nervous at the vet and grooming but they are treated with love, care and respect at King’s Crossing in Kingwood! 🐾🩶
Love the entire facility.  The vets are awesome and Miss Sam - our groomer is outstanding.  My Aussie loves her and always looks first class when we pick her up.  I get lots of compliments.
They really care and always treat my pets with such care and kindness. Highly recommend.
I love the Drs, Techs and front staff.
Everyone at KCV that I have had the pleasure to meet is absolutely wonderful!  The doctors are compassionate with the patients and they’re owners.  I’m so glad I found Kings Crossing !
Athena did a great job of grooming our dogs.   Professional, friendly and very up front about everything.    Will request her again.

Joan, thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We’re honored to be part of your pet’s care and appreciate your support. Everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital looks forward to serving you and your furry family members for years to come.

TB, thank you for the 5-star review! We’re grateful for your support and for trusting Kings Crossing Animal Hospital with your pet’s care. Our team truly appreciates it, and we look forward to seeing you again soon!
Once again a fabulous job on Shadow. Thank you so much Athena 🥰 …
My Beaux absolutely hates all clinics and groomers, but they kindly coaxed him into an exam room. Doc's and techs are all so kind and helpful. It's always a great experience!

Sam does an AMAZING job grooming  Sasha, our Cocker Spaniel. Sasha always looks beautiful after her visits!  Sasha was a little timid in the beginning and Sam has been very patient working with her.  Sasha loves her visits with Sam.  I highly recommend her!

The two star is for the boarding side of the business. My Buddy was there for 3 nights, I gave simple instructions with labeled bags. All bags were still filled besides the one bone and ofcourse his food. Did not give him treats nor his one chewy a day for teeth cleaning. His bones were for the evening when everyone left because he’s a shih-poo and very anxious.

I also noticed that he didn’t get any play time after I signed him up for that Thursday. It wasn’t on my bill.

When we arrived Friday June 12 to pick Buddy up, I noticed an employee walk a dog to go potty, I’m assuming and he didn’t even give that poor dog a chance. In and out- about 60 seconds.

I know my dog needs at least 5-10 minutes to find a spot and potty.

When we arrived home he was so lethargic and acting strangely. I don’t recommend their boarding & will not take him back.

The Vet side is OK!
Samantha is the very best!!  She is so patient with my Bodie.  And—-Bodie loves her.
Always been good to my dog. Have been going here for over a year now no problems. Staff is super nice
It may take extra waiting for your appointment time, but it is worth it because the personalized attention and care are exemplary.

I’ve been coming here for almost 10 years and the doctors/vet care staff are very kind. However, I’d plan an entire half of the day for this. Every year I wait a minimum of 30 min to an hour past my appointment time. They give no explanation other than “an emergency just came in” every single year.

Update: staff did not care at all that my pets sat almost 2 hours past appointment time. $615 (was quoted around $450 on the phone the other day) for a 2 hour wait and 10 min (if that) with the vet. We will not be back.

Final update: I spoke with the assistant manager today. She apologized for the wait time and is refunding me for the amount I was overcharged beyond my quote. While the visit wasn’t ideal, that speaks volumes for the practice and we have decided to give them one last try next year. Thank you for reaching out and trying to make it right :)

Excellent grooming by Samantha, as always. My pup comes home smelling sweet & looking pretty!

I've been continuing to use KCAH/Grooming Services for over a year and I'm always pleased with the professionalism and kindness of Samantha.  I have an active terrier mix and Samantha is always patient with her.  The grooming is exceptional.
Thanks again, Sam for another excellent grooming experience.

Tuesday 7/22/25
Just returned from picking up my pup for another great grooming experience by Samantha.  Samantha manages my nervous little terrier with the sweetest care and attention.  Thank you, once again for a great grooming experience.  Clementine is a smell-good happy pup!

I recommend KCAH not only for Vet services but grooming as well.  I've tried several grooming services and found Samantha to be the BEST.  She is kind and thorough, especially careful with nail trimming.  My pup is returned to me sparking clean and Happy!  Our very active terrier comes home smelling good - today she smelled like cinnamon!
Thank you Samantha for caring so much for my fur-baby.
Athenia always does a wonderful job with both my pups.. they love her

I’ve taken my doodle to get groomed here a few times now with Athena, and she is always so great with him. Shes also super sweet to just talk with. Very knowledgeable, and you can tell she 100% cares! Moose loves her as well!

Lori, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! Your support means a great deal to everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital. We’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pets and look forward to seeing you again soon.

Lily just needed a bath today and nail trim. She was excited to see Athena. She never balks at entering the facility. That is the main sign to look for when choosing a groomer. Athena always does  exceptional work, too.
Athena groomed Ruby today, she always takes special care of my senior Akita baby
Athena is a great groomer. Excellent skills and. Patient with Pb ,who is blind.

Recently had to take my cat in for an emergency appointment after he ate a long piece of string. Dr. Lamb and the Vet Tech were very kind and got our floof to vomit up the forbidden fruit. Gross, yes, but I’m grateful for their care!
The little guy was back to his normal shenanigans within 12 hours.

Frank, thank you for the 5-star review! Everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital truly appreciates your support and trust in our team. We’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pets and look forward to seeing you again soon!
They care about the animals for sure. They don’t care about your pocket AT ALL.  Other places are much cheaper for standard care.
They killed my cat with pricing, they wanted extra money for CPR…. If you have an emergency don’t come here. And you got to have thousands up front. No plans. Evil.

Codi, thank you for the 5-star rating! Everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital truly appreciates your support and trust in our team. We’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pets and look forward to seeing you again!
I have trusted all my animals to Kibgscrossing. We have gone there for over 20 years. They are great with my animals.
It was our first time visiting for my dog Gary. Everyone was great and caring. I’m glad we found our new Vet!
Thank you for scheduling My Fur Baby❣️Dr. B was amazing. We will definitely be making you his primary Doctor.
Great team of doctors and staff!
Friendly staff
Thank you Mr. Domingues for the 5 stars!

We just moved the area and didn’t have a primary vet for my pups yet but due to my dog not feeling well I had to go to the first hospital with available appointments. So glad I went to Kings Crossing! Amazing from the moment they picked up the phone; Steven was polite and professional during our intake phone call. Wait time was not bad and Dr. Lam was AMAZING! She listened to all my concerns and patiently answered all my questions. I sadly don’t have the techs name but she was great too. Prices were reasonable. I’ll bring my pets Max and Nova here from now on. Highly recommend!
We have taken our dog Rosie to Kings Crossing Animal Hospital for nearly five years, whether it's medical treatment or boarding, it's always first class

Dr. Johnson and staff are beyond expectations! Keep up the professional courteous knowledgeable patient service up.
Thank you.
MRZ

Took our dog in with an eye issue for an emergency and got seen right away. The staff was exceptional and so kind. Got him treatment and medicine right away and peace of mind! Can’t recommend them enough!
She was able to trim the nails and attach guards of my very agitated cat. She and her team were outstanding.
Thank you for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review. We really appreciate the 5 stars and I know this will warm Dr. Bumgarner and Julia's hearts. Have a great day!
King’s Crossing always does a great job—both in grooming and in veterinary care.

We’ve been going to kings crossing animal hospital since our first dog Biscuit was a 6 month old puppy, now she’s 3 and we have a 1  year old puppy Bean! The staff have been nothing short of AMAZING! We’ve seen almost every vet whether it was an emergency or annual vaccines. My dogs love them and so do we!!! They truly go all out making sure all of our questions have been answered all of our concerns are carefully examined!

I won’t say they’re the cheapest but you pay the right price for great care for your special furry friends!

I was a little panicked, my cat was ill. The ladies at the desk 4-2-26 were so sweet and caring. The vet and vet tech were amazing, too. I wish I had caught their names to give them proper props. THANK YOU for taking care of my Pennywise!
Always so nice and really took care of my cats injury! They were able to squeeze me into the schedule last minute and very thorough
Professional

We have used Kings Crossing for both Vet and Grooming services are both are fantastic!  My two dogs especially love Ms. Sam with grooming!  She is incredibly kind and handles both with extreme patience.  One of my dogs gets extremely anxious away from home but she handles her she gently that I know she is in great hands.  Would definitely recommend!!
Robin and the whole staff at Kings Crossing always do an excellent job. I would never even consider taking my dog anywhere else.
Samantha has been grooming my golden retriever, Samson, for almost a year now and she is the best. She is very patient and gentle with Samson and he always comes out looking fabulous.
I love this place!!!  Everyone is so kind and loves animals.  I wouldn't take my dog anywhere else.
Athena was so great! You can tell she really cares and my dog came out looking so cute!

I only have good things to say about this Animal Hospital. They’re easy to work with and always treat everyone with kindness. My fiancée’s family has been going to them for years for all their pets so it was an easy choice for us when deciding where we would take our newly adopted greyhound.
Athena is always wonderful! My babies love to be groomed by her. And she absolutely loves animals
They saved my baby Twyla, will forever be grateful for that.
Sam is our favorite groomer!  She is so gentle and does such a great job grooming Bear!  He always looks absolutely perfect when she’s done.
Sam is fantastic!!!  She has been grooming for us about 10 years.  She does a great job on my two fur babies and they love her!
We have used Kings Crossing Animal Hospital for over 20 years. We always receive great service. The staff is kind and professional. Dr. Johnson is wonderful with our dogs.

Have been taking my 4 legged kids to this vet for years. Doctors, Techs and staff are outstanding. And their grooming and boarding service are excellent. As soon as I walk in with my 108lb German Shepherd, as soon as his groomer, or Tech walks out, he forgets I even exist...lol
Athena and crew did a great job with my pup today. They were able to get her in and out in the time I requested, which I greatly appreciated. Would use them again!

Almost don’t want to write about how amazing Athena is because I don’t want her to get booked up! But we literally searched for her and followed her from a previous facility because she is that good!!! She’s so so sweet with our pups and so communicative. We are always more than happy with her work!!! Can’t recommend her enough.
Kings Crossing and Dr Johnson are the best!!! They know our pets and exactly what’s best for them. Always feel well cared for and loved.
We have struggled to find good care for our pet. King’s Crossing Vet is our new place to go for excellent care and friendly staff
Sam was excellent at grooming our Henry! He always comes home happy and looking cute.
Our Molly hurt her foot and they took excellent care of her!
Thank you so much Kim for the 5 stars and for being part of the Kings Crossing Animal Hospital family! If we can help in any way, know that we are here for you.

Sam is Cooper’s girlfriend. Yes she is his groomer, but he fell for her during the toughest time in his new life. And this is very special because Cooper is a rescue about 5yo when he came to me. He was unsure of what had happened to him and very defensive. In the months ahead, I worked on re-training him to trust people, and Sam  did the same through gentle bathing and grooming and reassuring him. Coop decided if his retired, odd new mom trusted this nice lady, he would too. He revealed his sweet nature in time and is a beautiful, loving little guy.  Sam gave him gentle, expert bathing and grooming and also has a talent for seeing the real dog within the grooming stage and revealing him to his delighted mom and friends. Hats off to this expert, talented stylist with the gentlest hands and heart. Cooper and I love and thank you for your skill and kindness.

KCAH is a wonderful place. Dr. Bumgarner is one of the kindest people you’ll ever meet and is a great vet. She is thorough, caring, and you never feel rushed when she’s examining your pet. The staff is always friendly, caring, and helpful. Highly highly recommend!

Sam does such a wonderful job grooming our two pomeranians. They always come out looking great! She is quick to listen and address any concerns or worries I have. I highly recommend her!

I also love the staff and veterinarians at Kings Crossing. They have helped us in many situations, from daily care to emergency care with our dogs and cats. We love Dr. Johnson and Dr. Lam. They take such good care of our girls and boys!
Excellent pet care and customer service always very pleasant and accommodating😻❣️

I started bringing my pups here after my longtime and very loved and trusted vet moved out of state. It has been three years now and   I have been very happy with Dr. Bumgarner and the care she provides my dogs. She is friendly, kind, knowledgeable and I trust her care of my pups. The vet techs are always good with my pups and show them love and care. Front desk is friendly and helpful, once you get their attention. This is the only area I see needing improvement. There doesn’t seem to be a real good system for check ins and check outs and you end up standing around 10 minutes, waiting to be acknowledged and checked in. Same thing goes for checking out. There will be 3-5 people at the desk but not one person acknowledges the  people waiting for assistance. They just finish whatever it is they are doing (paperwork, phone call) then address you when they are ready. A simple “I’ll be with you shortly” would go a long way. Stephen, when present, is always helpful, efficient and gets things moving. I give KCAH 5/5 stars because they give good quality care that you can trust and overall the staff is very caring and helpful. Just needs some improvements to check ins/outs.
Love the staff!  Always attentive and caring with my pups!
The best care for my fur baby.

We have been clients of Kings Crossing Veterinary Hospital for over 25 years for all of our pets. The staff is always so friendly and caring and helpful for all of our fur babies. Doctors Johnson and Bumgarner are our preferred vets. They are both amazing and caring veterinarians.   Kings Crossing is not the cheapest vet around, but we think they are the best and we highly recommended them for your pets.
Kings Crossing Animal Hospital never disappoints they have amazing staff and doctors. Want to thank each and every one of them for taking such good care of our Solomon. Thank you!
Fantastic staff.
Best vet experience ever. Dr Johnson was lovely!  Her techs and staff were informative and friendly.

My dog injured her ear during the night and they were wonderful and were able to fit me in today and took care of everything very professionally. The receptionist Jennifer was wonderful when I called and was very upset and concerned about my dog and she was very calm and extremely helpful. This is the only place that I take my pets and I will not go anywhere else.
Thank you for the 5 star rating! The team at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital appreciates your support!

Exceptional veterinarians, very nice and able assistants and technicians! Always ready to help, anytime! Been a customer for 20+ years with 5 rescue dogs as customers over the years! Y’all are the best!
Dr Johnson and staff are always caring, patient and efficient.  We feel like Dr Johnson takes a personal interest in our pets and we have a high degree of trust in her.
Thank you so much for the 5 star rating! The team at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital appreciates your support! Have a wonderful day.

Wonderful staff and facility. Dr. Lam is so gentle with our puppy and extremely knowledgeable.
Lucky to have this vet hospital so close to us

We love King’s Crossing. They’ve taken such good care of my new rescue and all of her crazy conditions. She has recovered beautifully!! They have also taken great care of my senior girl, Mercy. With a nervous momma’s heart they have answered my questions and calmed my nerves about dentals, anesthesia and senior dogs. Wonderful reception staff, technicians, and doctors!!! Highly recommend!!! 🤗

Darlene, thank you so much for the 5-star review! Everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital truly appreciates your support and trust. We’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pets and look forward to your next visit.

Tango always gets excellent care from
the staff and Dr Johnson!!
Just got his yearly well doggie check!
Thank you everyone!!

Gail, thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and your trust in Kings Crossing Animal Hospital. Our team is grateful for the opportunity to care for you and your pets, and we look forward to seeing you again soon!
The staff is wonderful and very helpful. The vet listen and address your concerns
Everyone was amazing and cares so much for all my animals just love this clinic.

We love this vet practice! We recommend dr. Johnson to anyone whenever they’re searching for a veterinary practice to go to. We have gone here for a Marriott of different pet experiences. From the loss of our first dog (they were amazing during that traumatic ordeal), to the neck/shoulder injury of our precious 9 year old Pomeranian (their MLS laser therapy combined with medication and time did AMAZING!), to bringing in our new little baby Pomeranian into the fold and getting her beginning care all taken care of! Even with cats they’re awesome! Our tortie had a large fluid filled growth on her belly that connected to a nipple oddly enough, and they were able to rule out cancer same day!

We love dr Johnson, and the entire staff! They’re amazing at answering the phone and helping with minor questions if you have any, and if the vet needs to be consulted for your question they are very quick to call back same day!

And the pricing is pretty great too. I mean it’s “expensive” but imagine getting your healthcare, vaccinations, or surgeries without insurance?! The animals deserve the same level of care as you do! And this is just the place 🩵 (but for real, get pet insurance. Better safe than sorry.
Attached is a photo of our baby Pomeranian with the lovely Jennipher!

This is the worst of the worst.  Do not I repeat do not take your animals here if you love your animals. This place is ALL about getting pay and nothing about your dog. After waiting for more than half hour after my appointment time I left because I couldn’t . Then I call to get an appointment and I am told the it has to be a doctor the person the inject a sytopoint I hope is spell correct. And other times the vet technician has administer this injection to my dog.  All they want to do is up charge you. At least that’s my experience in this place. So if you have a lot of money to giveaway go to this place. But I don’t recommend at all.  Check your bill statement before you leave this place.

Nothing but satisfaction and praise for the care and service Dr Lam and Samantha provide for our pup Emmylou.  It’s the first time any pet of mine has looked forward with excitement for going to a grooming or vet  visit.

I started coming here when I moved to Kingwood. My dogs are both seniors. I love how they explain each vaccination and let me choose which ones to get and let me save my money on the unneeded ones. They’re very sweet and understanding. My dogs are treated like royalty. I’ve had dogs my whole life and never truly enjoyed a visit until now.
Everyone from the front desk personnel to the vet techs to Dr. Lam were great. Dr. Lam took her time and discussed options for treatment. All around a great experience for both me and our furry baby.

Went with an emergency and the team was able to help me and got my dog in for checkup. Front desk team was specially attentive and helpful. Veterinary and assistant were amazing and talk through everything that they saw, how to attend it and options at home. I am very please with the attention, staff support , and price of services.

Ive been taking my pets to Kings Crossing for years now. Their personal care and medical care of the pets is excellent. Also great care and communication with the pet owner. Thank you, Kings Crossing!
Groomer Athena is so special in her care and compassion for grooming our senior nearly blind dog. She provides an exceptional grooming in spite of the difficulties.

The staff at the front desk is amazing. They are friendly, informative, knowledgeable, & organized. Dr. Johnson was thorough with her examination of our dog. She explained, in detail, the issues our dog had. She had read notes from the previous vet prior to our appointment. We will continue to use Kings Crossing Animal Hospital for our pet.
We have brought both of our pets here since moving to Kingwood! They are always super responsive and accommodating of our requests.
The staff & vet are very thorough & friendly great first time experience.

I use this office for both vet care and boarding
They are very responsive and loving towards my pets  and are very knowledgeable I. The care of my breed of dog
My dog Piper sees Dr. Lam. She is kind and compassionate. The staff is friendly and competent.  Dr. Lam listens to our concerns and we never feel rushed.  I trust Dr. Lam caring for my dog Piper.
All of my pups love the staff here. Everyone seems to truly love their jobs and the animals. The couple of times we've had to say goodbye to fur babies, they've been so kind and patient.

VERY  thorough and AMAZING STAFF!!
WE LOVE DR. LAM!!
This establishment watched over my employers canine for 6 days. Definitely very clean and calming customer service.

I have had wonderful experiences with Dr. Johnson at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital. Dr. Johnson takes her time, asks questions, and cares about her furry patients and their humans. Even though I have moved 45 minutes away, I still come back to see Dr. Johnson.
We’ve taken our cats to this animal hospital for 20 years. They really are the best you can find.
My pups and I have been very happy with the level of care from everyone at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital and Grooming
Caring Veterinarian for your furry family friends.
Dr Lam and Mrs Jenny are the sweetest. Everyone is so nice and knowledgeable. I bring both my dogs here and I tell everyone to come here. I trust them so much. They do such a great job.
Everyone is very kind and patient here. I have a reactive dog and I’m always nervous bringing him to the vet but they are always great with him.
Been bringing our babies here since 2006. That should tell you what our experience has been here. Great docs, great staff, great front office crew...great practice.
Charles, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose Kings Crossing Animal Hospital. We look forward to caring for your pet again soon!
100% recommend! I was especially pleased with the Samantha’s grooming skills as she left my boy looking more handsome than ever for the holidays. Will be returning soon!

Sam in grooming is the best groomer you could ask for. She's attentive not only to your needs but the needs of your pet. She truly loves the animals she cares for and it shows not only in her work, but also the personal bonds she makes with the pets in her care.
Athena is amazing in the grooming department! She is so kind and patient! She will make your fur babies feel pampered and relaxed for their spa day!

Athena is the best with catching health issue’s throughout my pet’s coat. We had to play process of elimination to find out what was going on with my big girls skin, come to find out it’s grains! I also was helped by Stephen who was very knowledge with the vaccinations I need
Athena is a great groomer! Super patient, kind, and great with animals. My pet looked fantastic and was calm and happy afterward. Highly recommend!
Athena’s (at Kings Crossing Grooming) skills are the best without question! She is great with our pup and she adds flare for special occasions. We can’t wait for the next one!

I had been bringing my tiny little 5 pound fur- baby to Samantha for about a year and she took excellent care of him until his passing. It was because of the trust I had in her care with him that I decided to bring my other dog to see her as well. This Chihuahua mix has a lot of anxiety and so I know that Samantha will do a great job calming her down, while still doing a great job with the grooming appointment. Sam is quite the professional, and when I leave my babies in her care; I feel total trust and confidence that she will get the best job done in the safest and most gentle way for them.
I love this office, especially Dr. Baumgartner. They're respectful of your time, and I've never felt gouged like I have at other vets.

I had a wonderful experience at Kings Crossing Animal Hospital! The staff was incredibly caring, professional, and attentive to my pet's needs. The veterinarians Dr. Johnson took the time to explain everything thoroughly and made sure my pet felt comfortable throughout the visit. The facilities are clean and well-maintained, which gave me peace of mind. I truly appreciate their compassionate approach and dedication to animal health. Late in the evening, my Chihuahua (Popcorn) started to experience what appeared to her choking on something, however, she wasn't choking.

She was taking short, shallow, breaths, mixed with a gagging noise and behaving as though she was in distress. Her little body was shaking and she was clearly scared. I was, too.

I quickly researched the Internet and came across an article that described a condition called "Reverse Sneezing. She had all the symptoms described in the article, so I thought that's what was happening. The article stated that the condition was short lived and she'd soon be back to normal. However, that didn't happen.

The next morning she was still exhibiting the same symptoms, so I rushed her to Kingwood Crossing Animal Hospital who have taken care of her since she was only 8 weeks old.

Dr. Centers exam her and wasn't able to, definitively, find a cause of her condition other than perhaps she was experiencing a reaction to the pollens in the air. Houston is notorious for pollen allergies, especially this time of the year. I agreed with her diagnosis and brought her home with the unstanding that if it continued, I'd take her back for possible X-rays.

In the meantime, Dr. Centers prescribed steroid medications to help her overcome the allergy and by late afternoon Popcorn was back to being her old self and I was a very relieved pet owner.

I have been using the services of Kingwood Animal Hospital for over 14 years and the staff there have always taken exceptional care of Popcorn and my Australian Shepard (mix), Charlie.They are very courteous and friendly and the care is top notch.

In addition to the veterinarian services, the staff in the grooming department are equally as courteous, friendly and very professional.

I highly recommend Kingwood Animal Hospital and am grateful for the care they give my little companions.
